detail: a monumental counterweighted atlas folio bound in pigskin and brass mesh, its colossal vellum leaves open on a canted granite lectern, meticulously illuminating certified terrain, settled kingdoms, and physical constants with microscopic calligraphy and hand-ground mineral pigments

evidence.quote: The Atlas as a context pack: ontology + lore + skills + mission. Atoms keyed by region: identity, ontology, terrain, actors, laws, history, state, affordances.

facts.extent: 2.5-meter wide open atlas folio on a granite pedestal
facts.scale_ref: requires two clerks turning cranked brass levers to turn a single page
facts.material: cured pigskin, brass corner brackets, calfskin vellum, lapis lazuli and vermilion inks
facts.state: immaculate, dry, slowly updated on a timescale of years

note: The supreme document of the Bureau. What is drawn within its leaves exists by imperial warrant; what is excluded has no legal reality. Resists narrative drift and context rot.
